data.name: Witch Thief
data.detailed_description:
Play as the snarky Witch Thief, on her quest to steal all the magic she possibly can! Naturally those who have the magic don't want to give it up so she does what she does best.
That is, kicking in the front door and taking it all anyway!

Dodge duck and weave through terrifyingly intricate patterns of magical projectiles as you seek the greatest treasure of all. The Ancient and powerful Grimoire!

Features:

Unique Bullet-Hell Perspective

Unlike other Shmups, Witch Thief gives you control of a full 3D camera. Rather than the classic birds eye view, you will witness bullet hell from a whole new perspective!

Dodge intricate bullet patterns

Terrifyingly intricate storms of bullets will rain down as you journey on your quest. Study, learn and apply your dodging skills to outmaneuver the incoming perils.
Touching even one bullet will kill you - so beware!

Unlock a range of quirky playable characters

Choose to play one of many Witches. Experience fresh new dialogue, different bosses and unique spells to achieve their goals.
Each character has unique spells and dialogue, and may encounter different and challenging bosses on their path to the Grimoire.

Musical tracks

A fully original soundtrack, accompanying you on your perilous journey to the Grimoire.
Each character and stage has a unique theme that captures and plays upon their essence.

Battle Relentless Bosses

Your path is not an easy one. Face insane bosses, wielding great magical power and unleashing torrents of complex bullet patterns. They will stop at nothing to protect the Grimoire.

Unravel a world of mystery

As you explore and overcome every stage of the game learning more about the world first from the perspective of the Witch Thief, but later as many other unlockable characters you will experience new perspectives of the story.

Accessibility options

Everyone should be able to have fun and play games. We’re always striving to help people play and include these features into Witch Thief to help out. If there are any features you’d like to see please shoot us an email and we’ll see what we can do!

  • Rebindable keys: Nothing is worse than a control scheme that doesn’t work for you! Witch Thief’s controls can be rebound across keyboard, mouse and controller.
  • Dyslexic font option: We love our stylized fonts, but we want you to know what’s going on. A dyslexic font option is available for all in-game text.
  • Difficulty ranges: Not everyone wants the hardest difficulty. Witch Thief ranges from practically no combat “Chill” mode to the extreme “Insanity” mode which increases both bullet counts and speed. Oh you only get one life there too.

Disclaimer:

  • Bright Colours
  • Flashing Lights
  • Camera Shake
If you encounter something in Witch Thief that you feel should be in this Disclaimer, please reach out!

Check out Cardboard Keeps entire catalog of games for more amazing experiences!

reviews.review:
[h1] A more than decent bullet hell game[/h1]

I love bullet hell games, being one of my favourite subgenres, what this game has and others mostly don't it's the: be touched once and die factor, meanwhile most of the games related to this genre work with health bars you just have one chance in the hardest difficulty and if defeated you will go back to the start of the chapter, now that is hell (and I love it).

[h1] Gameplay[/h1]

A 3D game with the bullet hell theme is not common, is something hard to make, not only to sync all the sounds, but to develop what I believe could be a successful game of this genre.

[b]Scenario [/b]
We fight in a closed environment with very few secondary paths, most of the time we will fight during the night or inside buildings and raising the camera will enable us to watch everything at their best.

The plot has hardly any presence and you do not even have to look for it, the main plot in itself is a deconstruction of the typical premise of ending evil and saving the world because you are the chosen one, this time with a few changes adding some extra characters for a replayability factor and fight the evil from another point of view.


[h1] More deeply[/h1]

The controls in this game are very simple, we can dodge bullets and cast special spells but we won't be able to block anything.

[b]Enemies [/b]
All enemies use ranged attacks since the simple contact with them will make us perish, (except some suicidal ones that will try to catch us). Our enemies will be way stronger than us but predictable as well, so we can evade their attacks far in the background while learning their patterns, sadly there are not many creatures to fight against (quantity but no quality).
 

[b]Difficulty[/b]
A total of five difficulty modes are included on this game, from chill to insane, the first one being for practicing and newcomers to the subgenre or having fun without worrying about losing. On the other hand we got the insane mode, a classic on most games, if you are touched by anything is game over, it may seem too extreme for a bullet hell game but training will make most of the attacks predictable and eventually we will become masters of the genre.

When they announce a game that is difficult, we look further into it because we want games to challenge us and not hold our hands while playing. 

Is witch thief a hard game? No, bullet hell games are made to be strict (exigent). Like your math teacher, shows the basics of his mechanics and prepares you for the worst, so when you get comfortable, it gives you a surprise test to see if you can really handle the situation, the level design and the positioning of the enemies is predictable and in overall Witch thief could be three or four times better changing a few of this things to good.

[h1]Rating[/h1]

[b]Pros[/b]
•Difficulty friendly: Have you mastered the bullet hell genre or do you have sleepy hands and cannot manage to move through the environment properly? The game cover all of this users with five different difficulty modes, including a mode where getting oneshoted means start from the beginning of the chapter.

•A good game to introduce newcomers to the genre: I may already said this more than once but anyway, after the recent Furi update of invincible mode, everyone is able to play the game and feel the story with no problems, now, this game is not that hard since even the bullets are not fast enough and we got enough time to evade them

[b]Cons[/b]
•The problem is not visual but narrative, as we move forward the game will stop explaining our purpose to just some very short dialogues between bosses and our character (till the very end) and all our task will be to kill and survive.



[h1]Final thoughts.[/h1]
One of the cons that I'm going to include here is the price, most of bullet hell games with this price come from big studios and I'm afraid people won't trust a fairly not very known studio with this game price unless they are good at marketing.

Also they are aiming for releasing the game into consoles and as far I can remember Furi is the only bullet hell game I got in my ps4 so it will be nice to count with another.

Also, when people are made to a challenge, they can beat it with the eyes closed, something I like about games is the random generated encounters mode, that will eventually be added to the game and expand it to not just a history with a start and ending.
